title: V3.4 Independent Human Event Screening Schema
description: Schema for events discovered independently during full-scene blinded human review, without AI candidate cues.

human_event_id.description: Unique identifier for human-discovered event (e.g., HEVT_WH026_001).

camera_set.description: Camera streams where the event is visibly discernible.

start_time.description: Start timestamp of observed interaction / intervention in stream (seconds).

end_time.description: End timestamp of observed interaction / intervention in stream (seconds).

event_type.description: Operational categorization assigned by the human assessor.

visible_intervention.description: Whether an active, intentional safety intervention was visually confirmed.

objects_involved.description: Observed physical entities participating in the event.

primary_zone.description: Primary location of the interaction / intervention.

secondary_zone.description: Adjoining zone monitored for spillover or displaced hazard.

notes.description: Human assessor narrative of the event context, mechanics, and environmental conditions.

screening_confidence.description: Assessor confidence in the classification and time boundaries.

reviewer_id.description: Anonymized identifier of the blinded human reviewer.

linked_candidate_id.description: Cross-reference link to matching AI candidate ID if dual-discovered.
